title: Fine for travel. Will not replace full sized iron!
text: Fine for travel. Will not replace full sized iron!. Fine little travel iron. But nothing super special. In order to get your clothes pressed decent, you must press the steam button down 100% of the time that you're using it, which is a pain. And may be unreasonable if you have arthritis or other mobility issues with your hands. It's small. It is not heavy. It does not move as nimbly as a full size iron. It does not press as well as a full size iron. But, if you have no space  or you literally iron only 1 or 2 times a year, it would be fine.

product_metadata.title: IRIS USA Mini Handheld Garment Steamer, Clothing Steamer, Powerful Handheld Garment Iron Steamers, Horizontal and Vertical Ironing, 35s Fast Heat-up, Portable Mini Steamer for Home and Travel, White
features: Portable iron and steamer is the ideal solution for removing wrinkles from clothes and house hold fabrics
Travel steamer 2 ounce water tank offers clothes steaming run time of up to 5 and a half minutes
2 pound, lightweight steam iron is compact for easy maneuverability and fits comfortably in bags or suitcases for travelling
The travel clothing steamer and iron comes with heat resistant base for storing during cool down and measuring cup for trouble-free refilling of the water tank
Dimensions: 6. 5"L x 2. 8"W x 5. 1"H (Iron only), 7. 1"L x 3. 3"W x 5. 9"H (Including base)
description: The compact solution to keeping fabrics wrinkle-free, even on the go. This travel sized steam iron heats up in under a minute, and the indicator light makes it easy to see when it’s ready for use. The 2 ounce steamer water tank offers up to 5 minutes and 30 seconds of steaming time, and the convenient measuring cup makes refilling the steamer water tank easy. The handheld steam iron is lightweight and perfectly sized to carry along in luggage or to maneuver over household fabrics. It can be used either as a travel iron, allowing for standard ironing, or as a fabric steamer. For use as a travel clothes steamer, simply hang garments on a hanger, press the button, and let the lightweight steam iron perform its magic. The extra-long cord makes it easy to reach hanging clothes or fabrics. When finished, rest the portable steam iron on the heat resistant base while it cools. The heat of the steam can also be beneficial for helping sterilize and remove odors from fabrics. Travel sized iron weighs only 2 pounds. Perfect for use on everything from suits, dress shirts, and sweaters to curtains, pillows, and more.
